name: Peoria
seo_title: Peoria Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Peoria, AZ: the Peoria Holiday Festival, Candy Cane Lane at the Sports Complex, A Christmas Carol and The Nice List.
lede: Peoria celebrates with a free downtown Holiday Festival, a Sports Complex Candy Cane Lane and holiday stage shows at Theater Works and Arizona Broadway Theatre.
celebrates: Downtown Peoria is the center of the season. The City of Peoria's Arts and Culture team throws a free Holiday Festival around Osuna Park and the Peoria Center for the Performing Arts, with Santa's arrival, a holiday tree lighting, aerial cirque, a Nutcracker ballet performance, live music and the Peoria High School Choirs. More than 85 craft vendors and over 25 food vendors fill the streets, and Second Saturdays bring extra shopping downtown. Nearby, the Peoria Sports Complex turns its grounds into Candy Cane Lane, and two local theaters stage family holiday shows.
lastyear: Last year the City of Peoria described its holiday festival as the lighting of the downtown holiday tree surrounded by live entertainment, holiday shopping, festive activities and Santa. A City of Peoria Facebook post showed a large crowd gathered under falling artificial snow in front of a massive, brightly lit Christmas tree, with families enjoying the festival. The city bills the tree lighting as its official kickoff to the holiday season, and the festival keeps admission and nearby parking free.
facts: The Peoria Sports Complex is the spring training home of the San Diego Padres and Seattle Mariners, so the same fields that host baseball in March hold a Christmas night in December. The Holiday Festival is split between several downtown spaces, including Osuna Park, the Peoria Center for the Performing Arts and the Patena Community Center, which holds indoor crafts and movies. The city's festival page promises more than 85 craft vendors and over 25 food vendors, with admission and parking free.
trains: Peoria has no passenger rail, so the nearest holiday train fun is across the Valley. Maricopa Live Steamers in Glendale runs free Holiday Lights Train Rides on select evenings, and our Glendale page lists the dates. For a year round train visit, the Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler preserves historic railroad cars, and McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale has scale model trains and a miniature railroad. Both are a long drive from Peoria, so plan a full outing.
train_links: Historic railroad cars and a volunteer run museum in Chandler.
Scale model trains and a miniature railroad in Scottsdale.
traditions: Downtown Peoria's holiday tree is lit at the city's festival, which the city calls its official kickoff to the season.
Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive at the festival to greet families, along with roaming holiday characters.
The festival stage features performances of The Nutcracker and aerial cirque acts.
The Peoria Sports Complex opens for an evening of Santa photos, snow and bubble play and bounce houses.
Downtown Peoria adds shopping and local vendors on the second Saturday of each month, including December.
kidfact: The Peoria Sports Complex is the spring training home of the San Diego Padres and the Seattle Mariners.
faq: Is there a free Christmas event in Peoria?

Yes. The City of Peoria's Holiday Festival has free admission and free parking in downtown Peoria. It includes Santa's arrival, the tree lighting, live performances, craft and food vendors, and activities at the Patena Community Center. Check the city's festival page for the current year's date, stage schedule and map before you go.
Where can kids meet Santa in Peoria?

Santa and Mrs. Claus visit the Peoria Holiday Festival in downtown Peoria, and the Peoria Sports Complex offers Santa photos at Candy Cane Lane. Each event listing on this page gives the date and time, so choose the evening that fits your family.
What holiday shows are in Peoria?

Theater Works stages A Christmas Carol at its theater on 83rd Drive, and Arizona Broadway Theatre presents a children's morning show called The Nice List. Both list performance dates and times on their own sites, and each listing on this page links straight to them for tickets.
Is there a train ride near Peoria?

Peoria has no holiday train of its own. The closest free option is Maricopa Live Steamers in Glendale, which runs Holiday Lights Train Rides on select evenings. The Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler and McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale are good year round options for train fans.

Downtown Peoria is around Peoria Avenue near 83rd Avenue, where Osuna Park and the Peoria Center for the Performing Arts sit. The Patena Community Center is part of the festival area. Parking nearby is free during the festival, and the city publishes a map on its festival page.
sources: Holiday magic is taking over Downtown Peoria
intro_html:

The magic runs from December 4 (A Christmas Carol at Theater Works) through December 23 (The Nice List at Arizona Broadway Theatre), with the Peoria Holiday Festival (December 12) and Candy Cane Lane at Peoria Sports Complex (December 11 and 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
